title: When the Spire Breaks
author: Noor Winterbourne
blurb: Ansel Eriksen, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
